objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document; not language-independent and the same for all languages.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign authorizations for readers via a user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute in which the Creator is automatically confirmed by default; the value can be changed.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for a document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for a document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is counted after release of a document.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid from and the Period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are kept before physical deletion.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects distribution of workflow tasks when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to document detailed steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating new documents; document templates and validity periods can be defined for it.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system to create a new document or add additional information or attachments.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object with which documents in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example and attribute reference with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained via the document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Attribute reference maintained via the document properties to link documents.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Attribute maintained via the document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement a document with additional information; released and published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document associated with a main document and automatically released with the release of the main document.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Relevant equipment or document attachment that can be added to a document and reactivated with it.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual who can be assigned roles, authorizations, workflow tasks and distribution.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual person assigned personal authorizations or assigned to distribution.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorizations, reader assignment and distribution.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned specifically to documents to assign read and change rights.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role whose users can view approved objects and access documents via the reader dashboard.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role whose assigned user signs the creation of the document in the first workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Role with personal change rights but no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role that checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role responsible for the document itself and its content and for deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role that can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for an existing document without affecting the document content or version history.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system 30 days before validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for revalidating invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document containing User Groups and persons for distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from recipients and documented without a signature.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed during workflow processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete workflow tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification used to inform users of workflow tasks, releases, change proposals and distribution.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display populated based on distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report for documents in the system.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language after release.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system for which document visibility can be specified.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more templates defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to a pure object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the content of a document with the implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document_as_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version on the web.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Change a released document, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group and person-related authorizations in the document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign authorizations for readers via a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign a user as author for the document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign a reviewer to the document.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign a releaser to the document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Additional info.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Create an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document or archiving it with the next release of the main document.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete the release step to finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject during review or release, causing cancellation for all subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: System informs users of status and existence of workflow tasks by e-mail notifications.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document the signatures of the individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, creating a new version automatically in editing status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: inform_author
evts.description: Inform the author of the underlying document by e-mail when a Change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed Change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension and update the Valid until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when the revised document version is released or when suspension has been declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for processing the request for AKS.

evts.name: check_request_for_aks
evts.description: Creator of the request checks the request and the document in the first AKS step.

evts.name: approve_aks
evts.description: Reviewers and releasers carry out review and subsequent approval of the AKS.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document out of force, set the last valid approved version to Out of force and revoke rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation in the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Reactivate an invalidated document by creating a new version and restoring metadata, properties, authorizations, distribution list, and archived Equippments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain the Distribution list in the cockpit for the document.

evts.name: assign_distribution
evts.description: Assign User Groups and persons to Distribution, automatically granting read authorization for corresponding documents.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request persons and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_author_team
evts.description: Author team receives an overview of unconfirmed acknowledgements and notification when all persons have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups in the document distribution list.

evts.name: list_document
evts.description: List documents relevant to the user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents in reports based on selected parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify for each document in a multi-client system in which clients it is visible.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to another document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference to the original document for a local addition.

o2o.description: A document has a corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be automatically linked with other documents; local documents can reference original documents.
Documents can be automatically linked with Master data.
IT applications can be maintained via document properties for linking.
Relevant companies can be maintained via document properties.
Areas of validity can be maintained via document properties.
References can be maintained via document properties.
A document can be supplemented with Additional info.
A document can be supplemented with Attachments; Attachments are associated with a main document.
Equippments can be added to each document and reactivated with the document.
User Groups can be assigned to a document for reader authorization, distribution and authorizations.
Persons can be assigned personal authorizations or distribution for a document.
Authorization groups are assigned specifically to documents.
Users can be assigned to User Groups.
Users in reader groups can view approved objects.
Users assigned to Authors User Groups are offered in author or co-author selection lists.
Users can be assigned as co-authors for a document.
Users assigned to Reviewer User Groups are offered in reviewer selection lists.
Users assigned to the releaser user group are offered in the releaser selection list.
A translator can translate released content into another language.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
A Distribution list is maintained for a document.
User Groups can be assigned to the Distribution list.
Persons can be assigned to the Distribution list.
Acknowledgements relate to a current document version.
Workflow tasks are completed with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented for each released document version and can be printed as document content.
Users involved in workflow are informed of workflow tasks.
Users receive e-mail notifications.
Dashboards list or assign corresponding documents.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
A translated language version of a document becomes visible after release.
For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.
